title: Tell me the truth: A system to measure the trustworthiness of Large Language Models
reasoning: The paper focuses on a quantitative methodology for measuring the 'trustworthiness' of LLMs based on their semantic compatibility with a factual knowledge graph. While the paper mentions ethics and values in its literature review and theoretical definitions of trust, its methodology and proof of concept are centered on factual/domain accuracy (specifically regarding supply chains) and do not evaluate or benchmark religion, morals, or ethics.
